wheels.notes: Black Badge: DriveClean/EPA list a 22 in configuration (the EPA row in the merged data has 22 in as standard); standard size for 2027 not stated on a page for that year, so recorded as an option next to the 23 in on the Cars.com 2027 Black Badge page. (US page; Canadian car assumed the same.)
Black Badge Coupe: 23 in forged aluminum wheels, P255/40R23 front / P295/35R23 rear.

heat_pump.notes: ArenaEV lists the Series II Black Badge (2026-) with Heat pump: Yes. ArenaEV is a spec database (EU-oriented) and lists the feature as "Yes" without saying standard or optional; read as standard. Rolls-Royce site not usable. ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional (it also says Yes for the 2019–21 i3, where it was a paid option), and its pages mix EU data.
